name: markuprelay
description: Read explicitly shared webpage instructions and element context from your MarkupRelay account.

defaultPrompt: Use MarkupRelay to show my shared webpage instructions.
Use MarkupRelay to apply my changes in this project.
interface.longDescription: Read webpage change requests explicitly shared from the MarkupRelay browser extension, with selected element context, DOM locators and optional screenshots. In a coding workspace, locate the matching source, implement the requested changes and record checks or blockers. Unshared notes are unavailable. Requires a MarkupRelay account and browser extension. No local companion or separate AI provider API key is needed.

positive.prompt: Use MarkupRelay to list my shared pages.
positive.expected_behavior: List Example Store — review demo with its URL. Do not claim to see browser tabs or unshared pages.

positive.description: Read the selected request with exact element context.
positive.prompt: Use MarkupRelay to show the change requested on my shared Example Store page, including the target element.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the request to rename Add to bag to Add to cart, leaving the price unchanged. Identify button [data-testid="tote-add"] and the captured DOM evidence. Do not claim code was changed.

positive.description: Filter shared pages without inventing matches.
positive.prompt: Use MarkupRelay to find shared pages matching nonexistent-review-project-719.
positive.expected_behavior: No matching shared session. Ask the user to share the intended page or clarify; do not silently substitute the Example Store page.

positive.prompt: Use MarkupRelay to get the screenshot attached to the Example Store button request. If none is attached, tell me that.
positive.expected_behavior: The seeded request has no screenshot. Report that a screenshot is unavailable; do not fabricate an image. The selected DOM context remains available.

positive.description: Record an implementation blocker against a chosen request.
positive.prompt: Use MarkupRelay to mark my Example Store button request blocked because its source repository is unavailable.
positive.expected_behavior: Record status blocked with the supplied reason against the selected fictional annotation. Confirm the record; do not claim implementation, verification or user acceptance.

negative.description: General knowledge needs no account data.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

negative.description: Generic coding explanation needs no captured page.
negative.prompt: Explain CSS flexbox with a short example.

negative.description: General web research is outside the shared annotation service.
negative.prompt: Search the web for the latest Chrome browser release notes.

review.commerce_description: No purchasing tools. Free includes three saved pages with agent sharing; optional Pro subscriptions are managed separately on markuprelay.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial public cloud release: OAuth account connection, shared webpage instructions, element evidence and implementation results.
